page_title: Plainer - Your files. A place to think.

sources.entry: Plainer - Workspace for notes and files with a planner view, timeboxing and an AI assistant whose changes you can undo. #freemium

summary.name: Plainer
summary.one_liner: Plainer is a workspace that combines notes, documents, files, planner views and an AI assistant in one place.
use_cases: Keep quick notes and documents in one place
Plan a day or week with hourly calendar blocks
Track recurring habits and weekly goals
Organize project tasks with dates and subtasks
Ask an AI assistant to improve or summarize your files
Store PDFs, images, Word and spreadsheet files in folders
summary.what_it_does: Plainer is a simple workspace for quick notes, full documents, uploaded files such as PDFs, images, Word documents and spreadsheets, and organized folders. Its planning features include tasks with subtasks, dates, times and repeats, a day list, a calendar hourly plan, a Gantt-style view, weekly goals and a completed list. An AI assistant can read selected notes and files and suggest changes, and the page says its changes can be undone. Users can save reusable AI commands. Speech can be turned into editable text when the browser supports it.
notable: AI assistant whose changes can be undone
Planner views including day list, calendar, Gantt and repeating tasks
Saved reusable AI commands that read selected files
Speech-to-text notes when browser supports it
caveats: Pricing details beyond the freemium label are not stated on the page
Page is largely example content; platform list beyond the web app is not stated
